outcome.answer: Decoupled Split Learning via Auxiliary Loss most directly reduces data exchange by avoiding backward error-signal propagation: it trains client and server partitions semi-independently with local loss signals, eliminating the need to transmit backward gradients while maintaining performance comparable to standard split learning [1]. FedCritic-MIMO also reduces communication through sparse exchange of shared critic parameters with error feedback, but it does not describe avoiding error-signal propagation [10].
